Definition: A skill that runs a deliverable-local consistency sweep across production documents in one deliverable.
A required runtime override identifying the deliverable path.
A brief control whose false setting is the normal safe default and whose true setting permits minimal corrections only with authorization.
Limits the sweep to named production documents and defaults to all production documents.
Sets conservative or aggressive finding posture and defaults to conservative.
A soft cap on reported findings that defaults to 10.
Checks folder and document naming consistency and defaults to true.
Flags numeric statements needing evidence review and defaults to true.
A first-pass detector that must complete unless tool use was excluded.
An output block for consistency issues.
An output item for absent files or references.
An output item for true contradictions.
An optional update target for durable decisions or accepted proposals only when explicitly authorized.
